title: Living for God, Suffering as a Christian

questions.question: Since therefore Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves with the same way of ____, for whoever has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:1 (ESV): "Since therefore Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves with the same way of thinking, for whoever has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,"

questions.question: so as to live for the rest of the time in the flesh no longer for human passions but for the ____ of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:2 (ESV): "so as to live for the rest of the time in the flesh no longer for human passions but for the will of God."

questions.question: The end of all things is at hand; therefore be self-controlled and sober-minded for the sake of your ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:7 (ESV): "The end of all things is at hand; therefore be self-controlled and sober-minded for the sake of your prayers."

questions.question: Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, since love covers a multitude of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:8 (ESV): "Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, since love covers a multitude of sins."

questions.question: Show ____ to one another without grumbling.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:9 (ESV): "Show hospitality to one another without grumbling."

questions.question: As each has received a gift, use it to serve one another, as good stewards of God's varied ____:
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:10 (ESV): "As each has received a gift, use it to serve one another, as good stewards of God's varied grace:"

questions.question: whoever speaks, as one who speaks oracles of God; whoever ____, as one who ____ by the strength that God supplies...
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:11 (ESV): "whoever speaks, as one who speaks oracles of God; whoever serves, as one who serves by the strength that God supplies—in order that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ. To him belong glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen."

questions.question: Beloved, do not be surprised at the ____ trial when it comes upon you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:12 (ESV): "Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial when it comes upon you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you."

questions.question: But rejoice insofar as you share Christ's ____, that you may also rejoice and be glad when his glory is revealed.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:13 (ESV): "But rejoice insofar as you share Christ's sufferings, that you may also rejoice and be glad when his glory is revealed."

questions.question: If you are ____ for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests upon you.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:14 (ESV): "If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests upon you."

questions.question: But let none of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or an evildoer or as a ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:15 (ESV): "But let none of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or an evildoer or as a meddler."

questions.question: Yet if anyone suffers as a ____, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in that name.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:16 (ESV): "Yet if anyone suffers as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in that name."

questions.question: For it is time for judgment to begin at the ____ of God; and if it begins with us, what will be the outcome for those who do not obey the gospel of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:17 (ESV): "For it is time for judgment to begin at the household of God; and if it begins with us, what will be the outcome for those who do not obey the gospel of God?"

questions.question: And "If the righteous is scarcely saved, what will become of the ungodly and the ____?"
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:18 (ESV): "And 'If the righteous is scarcely saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?'"

questions.question: Therefore let those who suffer according to God's will entrust their souls to a faithful ____ while doing good.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 4:19 (ESV): "Therefore let those who suffer according to God's will entrust their souls to a faithful Creator while doing good."

key_verse_text: Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, since love covers a multitude of sins.
